notes.title: Closed Beta Ends
notes.content:
The closed beta has come to a close after 7 snow filled days. Here are some stats from the first few days (Oct 23-30th) of the closed beta:
[list]
[*] 69 players redeemed their beta keys
[*] 65 players played (launched) the game
[*] 33,774 snowballs were thrown (on the cul-de-sac level)
[*] 23.68% Hit rate
[*] Furthest snowball hit: 102 feet
[*] Average distance: 15 feet
[*] 469 knockouts
[*] 148 rounds played (average players in round was 2.18)
[*] 4 rounds of full 6 player games
[*] 65,155 teleports
[/list]
In the days ahead leading up to our scheduled early access launch on November 30th we will be crunching on the feedback and the data we gathered. Stay tuned!
